basic_info.description: This top-floor 1-bedroom residence at Onyx on the Park offers the perfect blend of modern design, natural light, and an unbeatable location in sunny Potrero Hill. With a smart open layout, the home features a beautifully appointed kitchen with a large eat-in island, sleek countertops, and Barbosa cabinetry. The expansive bedroom, wide-plank rustic oak floors with radiant heat, and abundant windows create a warm and inviting space. Additional features include in-unit laundry, Nest thermostat, CAT6 wiring, video intercom, deeded storage, and secure 1-car parking, plus high-speed internet with Google Webpass. Residents at Onyx enjoy access to a spectacular shared rooftop terrace with panoramic Downtown views, a barbecue area, WiFi hotspots, and multiple lounge spacesideal for relaxing or entertaining. Located in the heart of vibrant Potrero Hill, near beloved shops, restaurants, cafes, Jackson Playground, and minutes from Mission Bay, Oracle Park, and Chase Center, this location is an urban paradise with everything you need so close to home.
